commitResults.messageBody: Update the Java entry point, startup message, and documentation so the project consistently uses its new name.
Display a playful dragon banner, greet the user, and exit cleanly. Update the documented output and record the student's beginner experience level.

commitResults.messageTitle: Echo commands until the user says bye
commitResults.messageBody: Read user input in a loop so Toothless can echo each command, then exit with a cheerful farewell when the user enters bye.
Store user-entered tasks so Toothless can display them in numbered order when requested. Handle the list and bye commands explicitly while keeping responses friendly and varied.

Track completion state alongside each in-memory task and support the mark command so users can finish tasks while retaining Toothless's friendly tone. Show completed tasks with a star in list output, handle invalid task selections, and ignore the project-local visual diff skill so its installed files are not committed.

Allow users to reverse a task's completion state with the unmark command while preserving the friendly Toothless responses. Distinguish tasks that were already incomplete so the chatbot does not misleadingly report that their status changed.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent tasks with a Task class
commitResults.messageBody: Encapsulate each task's description, completion state, status icon, and display formatting in a dedicated Task class. Update Toothless to store Task objects so marking and unmarking behavior lives with the data it changes and future task types can extend the shared representation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add repeatable console UI testing workflow
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce a project-specific test-ui skill and test-plan template so console behavior can be checked consistently with fail-fast transcripts. Require agents to review the plan and invoke the skill after code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support typed tasks and clearer command guidance
commitResults.messageBody: Add Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses with polymorphic display and plain-string scheduling details. Extend Toothless command parsing while preserving existing task actions and legacy plain-description input, and add a friendly startup guide plus an end-to-end UI regression record.
Validate malformed commands before changing task state, provide actionable Toothless-themed messages, and add interleaved UI coverage to guard against regressions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor task deletion to use collections
commitResults.messageBody: Store tasks in a private ArrayList-backed TaskList so deletion can use collection operations while preserving order. Add Toothless-themed confirmations and comprehensive UI coverage for valid and invalid deletions.
Represent the fixed command set explicitly to improve type safety and centralize keyword conversion while preserving existing chatbot behavior.
